root_cause.text: The `b43legacy_rx` function in the b43legacy driver relies on a non-enforcing `B43legacy_WARN_ON` macro to validate a firmware-controlled key index, allowing execution to proceed with an out-of-bounds index and trigger an out-of-bounds read of the `dev->key` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces the non-enforcing check `B43legacy_WARN_ON(keyidx >= dev->max_nr_keys);` with an explicit conditional check `if (B43legacy_WARN_ON(keyidx >= dev->max_nr_keys)) goto drop;` to drop the frame. The commit message confirms that the existing macro is non-enforcing in production builds, allowing an out-of-bounds read of `dev->key[]` when the index exceeds `dev->max_nr_keys`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a guard check to drop packets with an invalid key index to prevent out-of-bounds memory access.
intent_record.what: Replaced a standalone warning macro with an if-statement that triggers a jump to the drop label when the key index is out of bounds.
intent_record.how: Prevents an out-of-bounds array access on the dev->key array by safely discarding the packet if the key index exceeds the maximum allowed limit.
